# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Performance or observability

## Verification

- [ ] I reviewed the affected task lifecycle or routing path.
- [ ] I updated docs or examples when behavior changed.
- [ ] I considered approval gates, cancellation, and error states.
- [ ] I ran the relevant local checks where available.

## Screenshots or traces

Add UI screenshots, task IDs, trace IDs, or terminal output when useful.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out risky areas, follow-up work, or protocol compatibility concerns.
